title: The Postcards of Room 214
author: Emrys Dunmore
blurb: Freya Ashgrove, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
